field.name: $formulaHelpViewer
field.viewer:
<>

{_t('A control type describes what is controlled and how. Its fields are split by usage: a field of usage "control plan" carries a reference value, entered once on the control plan line, and a field of usage "control entry" carries a value measured on each sample of the control entry. The formula compares the two and decides whether the sample is compliant.')}

{_t('It is evaluated when the inspector clicks "Check conformity" and must return')} true {_t('(compliant) or')} false {_t('(not compliant)')}.

{_t('Access to the values')}

{_t('Each field is available through its code, prefixed by its usage')}:

  • plan.code {_t('the reference value of the control plan line')}
  • entry.code {_t('the value measured on the sample')}
{_t('A decimal field gives a number, a text field a character string, a boolean field true or false, and a selection field the selected value, whose label is read with')} .name.

{_t('Examples')}

  • return plan.acceptedColor == entry.currentColor;
  • return (entry.mesuredDim >= plan.acceptedDimension - plan.minTolerance) && (entry.mesuredDim <= plan.acceptedDimension + plan.maxTolerance);
  • return !plan.isLabelRequired || entry.isLabelPresent;

{_t('A field flagged as required blocks the conformity check while its value is empty.')}
